subtasks.content: Read and extract tech stack details from `vscode-extension/package.json` (dependencies, devDependencies, VS Code engine version, extension metadata)
Read and extract build configuration from `vscode-extension/webpack.config.js` and `vscode-extension/tsconfig.json` (entry points, targets, compiler options)
Read and extract linting/formatting rules from `.pre-commit-config.yaml`, ESLint config, and Prettier config in `vscode-extension/`
Read and extract existing coding standards from `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md`
Read and extract CI pipeline details from `.github/workflows/ci.yml` and task runner commands from `Taskfile.yml`

Map the architectural layout of `vscode-extension/src/` (server/, core/, lsp/, ck3/, schema/, log/, data/, test/) by listing directories and reading key entry points (`extension.ts`, `server/server.ts`)
Write Section 1 (Project Overview) of `kanban-development-guideline.md` covering project purpose, repository structure, and tech stack with verified dependency versions
Write Section 2 (Architectural Patterns) documenting the VS Code extension + embedded language server architecture, subsystem boundaries, and data flow
Write Section 3 (Coding Standards) codifying TypeScript strict mode, naming conventions, formatting rules (Prettier), linting rules (ESLint), and error handling patterns
Write Section 4 (Preferred Libraries & Tools) listing runtime dependencies, dev tooling, task runner commands, and their intended usage
Write Section 5 (Development Workflow) documenting branching strategy, pre-commit hooks, CI pipeline, and PR process
Write Section 6 (Build & Test Commands) with exact commands for building, testing (unit/integration), linting, formatting, and packaging
Write Section 7 (Forbidden Practices) derived from linting rules, pre-commit hooks, copilot-instructions.md, and observed project conventions
Verify all file paths, dependency versions, and conventions cited in `kanban-development-guideline.md` against the actual codebase
